# iOS App Icon Staging

Generated on 2026-05-28 from:

`/Users/aelaguiz/Downloads/ChatGPT Image May 28, 2026, 05_59_01 AM.png`

The original PNG is copied here as `source.png`. It is `1254 x 1254`, RGB, and has no alpha channel.

Apple's current Xcode documentation says iOS and iPadOS apps can auto-generate icon variations from a single `1024 x 1024` image, and App Store distribution uses the iOS `1024pt` image well. This directory also includes a full explicit `AppIcon.appiconset` so it can be copied into an asset catalog later if we choose the all-sizes workflow.
